context: Tests whether the agent uses the correct ORC v2 JIT APIs (LLJIT/LLLazyJIT) instead of deprecated MCJIT, initializes targets in the right order, wraps modules in ThreadSafeModule with per-module contexts, adds DynamicLibrarySearchGenerator, and handles Expected<T>/Error correctly.

checklist.name: ORC v2 API used
checklist.description: Code uses LLJIT or LLLazyJIT from llvm/ExecutionEngine/Orc/ — does NOT use MCJIT (ExecutionEngine, EngineBuilder, createJIT, or #include of llvm/ExecutionEngine/MCJIT.h)

checklist.name: LLJITBuilder creation
checklist.description: JIT instance created via LLJITBuilder().create() (or LLLazyJITBuilder for lazy variant)

checklist.name: InitializeNativeTarget before JIT
checklist.description: InitializeNativeTarget() is called before the JIT instance is constructed

checklist.name: InitializeNativeTargetAsmPrinter
checklist.description: InitializeNativeTargetAsmPrinter() is called (without it the JIT cannot emit code)

checklist.name: ThreadSafeModule wrapping
checklist.description: IR modules are wrapped in ThreadSafeModule with a std::unique_ptr<LLVMContext> (one context per module)

checklist.name: DynamicLibrarySearchGenerator
checklist.description: DynamicLibrarySearchGenerator::GetForCurrentProcess() is added to the main JITDylib to expose host symbols

checklist.name: Error handling with ExitOnError or Expected
checklist.description: ORC API calls are wrapped with ExitOnErr() or explicit Expected<T>/Error handling — no unhandled return values

checklist.name: addIRModule usage
checklist.description: Modules are added to the JIT via JIT->addIRModule(std::move(TSM)) (not the old addModule API)

checklist.name: Symbol lookup
checklist.description: Functions are looked up via JIT->lookup("name") returning a symbol that is cast to a function pointer via toPtr<>()

checklist.name: InitLLVM in main
checklist.description: main() initializes with InitLLVM X(argc, argv) before any LLVM operations

checklist.name: No shared LLVMContext across modules
checklist.description: Does NOT construct multiple ThreadSafeModule instances sharing the same LLVMContext (each TSM gets its own context)

checklist.name: CMake llvm_map_components_to_libnames
checklist.description: CMakeLists.txt uses llvm_map_components_to_libnames() including OrcJIT component
